description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. The class manages the main screen of a notes app, including displaying a list of notes, filtering notes via a search bar, and handling navigation to note detail screens. It interacts with a content provider and database helper to load notes and update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity of the notes app, responsible for displaying and filtering notes, and navigating to detail views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, assigns UI elements, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes from the database when the activity resumes.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters the loaded notes based on the provided query string.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Queries the content provider to load notes into the list.

methods.name: updateAdapter
methods.description: Updates the UI adapter with a list of notes to refresh the display.
